build_count_tokens_endpoint: build the count-tokens endpoint URL for a Vertex AI partner model given project, location, and publisher
get_publisher_for_model: get the publisher name for a Vertex AI partner model like claude, mistral, or llama
strip_version_suffix: strip version suffixes like @default from a Vertex AI model name
handle_count_tokens_request: handle an async token counting request for a Vertex AI partner model and return input token count
create_token_counter_instance: create a VertexAIPartnerModelsTokenCounter instance to count tokens for Claude, Mistral, or Llama models on Vertex AI
